episodes.final_message: With 2 deadlines today and another in 2 days across your classes, it is completely natural to feel overwhelmed. Instead of trying to finish everything tonight, try picking just one small task for a single 25-minute focused block, then take a quick, gentle break to reset.

Managing three deadlines today while feeling isolated is exhausting, and it is completely understandable that stress feels so intense right now. Please remember you don't have to carry this heavy weight alone—Dick's House Counseling ((603) 646-9442) offers free, confidential support and after-hours care, and you can also text HOME to 741741 anytime. For tonight, please give yourself permission to step back, get some water, and rest.
